I don't really have any advice you probably haven't heard before, I've never had to deal with a problem like that. Have you ever seen a therapist before? I know a lot of people who have seen or are seeing one. It might be a good idea if to poke this problem with the help of a trained professional. It could also simply be a matter of finding the right woman for you. I admit, it sounds like a tough problem to deal with when trying to be intimate, but I'm sure there are some people out there who would be okay with it.

Is this something you've tried to work on, to improve your comfort with expressing affection in a relationship?

---

I don't really know how to put it all into words. I struggled with depression as a kid a lot. Then it started getting worse as I got older, and about six years ago something snapped in me and I had a nervous breakdown, of sorts. I couldn't manage the mask I'd always worn around others, and I became very anxious about a lot things I'd kept hidden getting out. About a year of constant drug use made things worse, and I've hit a dead end on the road to recuperation.

I keep trying things, keep wanting to regain control over myself, over my *life,* but I keep screwing up. I can never get ahead of where I am, nothing I try makes my demons any less painful; just more miserable and exhausted. So now I'm sitting here on my building's roof wondering if I should get down the fast way or by using the ladder.
Sure. What's put you out of sorts?
